product_flow.name: Parts and accessories of dolls representing human beings

required_qualifiers: complete head drawing configuration and human representation
whole supplied PVC plastisol composition inclusions and supplier boundary
single-charge liquid feed and electric closed-mould multi-axis route
actual mould construction and complete head integral geometry
unpainted unrooted supply state and no separately fitted eye or connector
actual grade colour retained water and material state without assumed formulation
actual site period supplier subcontract gate and real electricity voltage geography provider
calibrated scale tare configuration moisture and whole net first-release mass
actual whole-head specified inspection release test acceptance and disposition
unique new first-release Q and released closing FG included once
all physical raw WIP non-WIP FG stocks and per-exchange inherited burden vectors
actual original service cohort Qc and observed H with complete gross shipment return and state changes
every actual packaging pool six legs wet opening closing and one upstream owner
asset service and physical asset new old repair parts and fluid phase separation
actual molecular species phase media independent density and relevant element balances
actual work permission posttests continued acceptance negative outcomes hold and waste

product_flow.name: 人形玩偶的配件及装饰品

required_qualifiers: 完整头部图纸配置及人形属性
整份外购PVC塑溶胶组分包含关系及供方边界
单次液态投料及电加热闭模多轴路线
实际模具构造及完整头部一体几何
未涂装无植发供货态且无独立安装眼件或连接件
真实牌号颜色留存水及材质状态而无推定配方
真实场址时段供方外协门及真实电压地域供方
校准秤皮重配置含水及整件首次放行净质量
真实整头规格检验放行测试接受及处置
唯一新增首次放行Q及已放行期末FG计入一次
全部实物原料WIP非WIP及FG存量和逐交换继承负荷向量
实际原服务批次Qc及已观测H和完整毛发运退回及状态变化
各真实包装池六腿湿态期初期末及唯一上游所有者
资产服务与实物资产新旧维修件及流体相分离
真实分子物种相介质独立密度及相关元素平衡
真实作业许可作业后测试持续接受负面结果hold及废物
